notes.title: New Competitive Season + Free Halloween Skin!
notes.content:
[h1]New Leaderboard Season[/h1]
There's a few big balance changes that involve scoring and power buffs, so we're going to begin the next competitive season!

[h1]Free Halloween Skin[/h1]
Thanks for playing Harvest Hero Origins and joining our community, here's a Halloween treat!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40770594/f8b29f0568b228d7683d9ae2294e7d3bf0d7ca00.png[/img]


[h2]Patch Notes[/h2]
[list]
[*] New Ultra Difficulty! (+20% max score cap)
[*] Clones now have a 15 second time limit
[*] Score is halved in co-op mode (previously co-op games were able to accumulate twice as many points in the same amount of waves)
[/list]


[h3]Bug Fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] P2 Harvest Hero will no longer give all of their points earned by ground shockwaves to P1
[*] Shroomella and Zach charge meter bugs fixed
[*] Flame Guard SFX are now cleared on game over
[*] Clones no longer live on when the player dies :(
[*] Fix Flame Guard damage
[*] Toast notifications are now capped at 5
[/list]

notes.title: Summer Heat Update
notes.content:
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40770594/7cc036c7c46b35bdacc3d4c8020ae93e5a3298db.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40770594/e2f921e1c13f89e9c90bac11196d816017491f55.png[/img][/url]
[h1]New Hero: Shroomella, the Mushroom Witch[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40770594/db97de09c26eec00d2662c365f96daff8c4aebcd.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40770594/1e9ba786c34f9e5ad37523afa32b032a23b23569.gif[/img]

We've worked with our friends over at [url=https://twitter.com/RenaineGame]Octosoft[/url] to bring Shroomella to Harvest Hero Origins!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/662340/Renaine/]Renaine [/url] is an upcoming Action Platformer game about Aine, an immortal Phoenix Knight.

Shroomella is a Mushroom Shroom witch aiding Aine on her quest! She uses her variety of magical mushrooms to fight off the endless Grooble hordes. 

[list]
[*] Attack - Plant an explosive Bombshroom down in front of you!
[*] Blessing 1 - Gain the ability to kick Bombshrooms forward.
[*] Blessing 2 - Every 10th shroom planted is a Gigashroom, eating it will grant you temporary Gigantification!
[/list]

[h3]Bomb![/h3]
Place a Bombshroom in front of enemy paths to blow them to smithereens!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40770594/1e9ba786c34f9e5ad37523afa32b032a23b23569.gif[/img]

[h3]Kick![/h3]
If you miss their path, just kick your Bombshrooms at em!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40770594/e01c7eb0c4e7e1d063ee154a34b379aaf43869ad.gif[/img]

[h3]Grow![/h3]
And if all else fails, eat a Gigashroom and stomp your enemies out!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40770594/e376549e60e8adfbfda0658fc2037527e3726496.gif[/img]

[h2]And More![/h2]

Season 3 also begins today, climb to the top of the leaderboard and become the best!

On top of that, we're adding:
[list]
[*] A New Map
[*] 2 New Cards
[*] 2 New Enemies
[*] A revised story boss fight
[/list]

notes.title: Spring Fever
notes.content:
Hey everyone, we're extremely excited to bring this brand new content to Harvest Hero Origins. We've got a new hero, new enemies, new powerups, and a new map variant available, starting today!

[h2]New Hero: Blue[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40770594/0993dd1bf884f97f65aab04a1c44ce006df1af8b.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40770594/764ac04c11d52fd432106c0de9b6a2bf13cb55a8.gif[/img]

We've collaborated with [url=https://www.pixadome.com/]Pixadome[/url], the developers behind [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1454730/Chenso_Club/]Chenso Club[/url], to bring Blue to Harvest Hero Origins! Chenso Club is a side-scrolling platform brawler where combos are king, so I wanted to make sure we captured that in Blue's attack.

[list]
[*] Attack - Swing your chainsaw in a wide arc
[*] Blessing 1 - Combo Piece: Tap attack quickly to follow up with a second quick swing
[*] Blessing 2 - Combo Piece: Tap attack quickly once more to ride your chainsaw running over any enemies in your path
[/list]

Blue wields a chainsaw that she swings back and forth to deal quick damage, and is able to ride for a short period of time damaging all enemies in her path. Be careful though, because you'll overheat and have to restart your chainsaw!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40770594/5617b722b522e134b41126da96f5f64ad5b61c71.gif[/img]

[h2]New Enemies[/h2]
[h3]Grooble Roller[/h3]
The grooble roller rolls, as one might expect. However, it seems to roll in zigzagging patterns which is quite strange.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40770594/d11306d371e1206a3c3e9fd6404def16594e3fe7.gif[/img]

[h3]Grooble Digger[/h3]
The grooble digger is a crafty grooble, capable of traveling underground, only popping up when it needs air. Don't touch it or the dirt its tossing up or you'll get hurt!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40770594/7955023293078d2a9b3dc5715dc9ee3e5f213209.gif[/img]

[h2]New Power-ups[/h2]
[h3]Comet[/h3]
Gain control of a massive comet disintegrating everything it touches!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40770594/12af43aca49f6313ee5400172381fd398b1a3190.gif[/img]

[h3]Emerald Shield[/h3]
Blessed by the Tortoise, you become invulnerable to damage!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40770594/9e20138e7b3af9510028daf5cc3a35c22524e6a3.gif[/img]

[h2]Patch Notes[/h2]
[h3]Zack[/h3]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1381520/Cricket_Jaes_Really_Peculiar_Game/]Wishlist Zack's origin game Cricket here[/url]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40770594/20c45faedfadce30617fb7080309d7aef1a9b2a2.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Can now press "Attack" while lunging to cancel your lunge. This provides Zack with a more technical approach to moving and damaging. When canceling your lunge, you'll deal an additional damage at the stopping point.
[/list]

[h3]General[/h3]
[list]
[*] New: Leaderboard now supports scrolling up and down
[*] New: A music track player has been added to Survival mode, so you can select which song you'd like to play along to.
[*] Rename "Boxing Hero" -> "Zack". I felt it's better representation for Zack and Cricket to not dub over the name.
[*] Bug Fix: Maximum "delta" time is set to 1/60th of a second to prevent large frame skips
[*] Clone Nerf: Maximum of 5 clones at once
[/list]

notes.title: Harvest Hero Origins is now available!
notes.content:
[h1]Now Available[/h1]
It's been a long road getting here, but we're finally releasing! Who knew Summer 2021 was in February of 2022?


[h1]From PAX West to Steam[/h1]
To everyone who played the game at PAX West 2021, we thoroughly enjoyed watching you experience the game and your feedback helped us improve the game immensely. We hope you enjoy the game it has grown into since then.


[h1]Competitive Steam Leaderboards[/h1]

We want to embrace the competitive nature of arcade games by leaning into the leaderboard. Gemdrop Games will announce prizes in the future for the top players on the leaderboards when the first season ends (around end of March).

Also, don't forget to save your scores! "Save Score" is how your scores get uploaded to the steam leaderboards :D

notes.title: Releasing on February 8th!
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

Thanks for sticking around while we develop this game! We're very excited to announce we'll be launching the game this upcoming Tuesday on February 8th, with a launch discount of 10%!

Spread the word, tell a friend, tell an enemy, tell your mom and dad! We really hope you enjoy the game that we've worked so hard on, and can find an enjoyable and long lasting arcade wave defense experience in Harvest Hero Origins.

Compete on the leaderboards with your favorite hero and skin, play local co-op or online (steam remote play) with a friend, and play through the origin story of the Harvest Hero.

We'll be keeping an eye on any bug reports at launch, and will be adamant about being quick to respond.

Thank you all!

notes.title: Steam Leaderboard Support
notes.content:
Hey Harvest Heroes!

We've been plugging away at this game and are getting very close to completion! I just wanted to give you a quick update and let you in on what's new from the demo that was available at PAX West.

The biggest feature we've been working on is Steam Leaderboard support! With Steam Leaderboards, you'll be able to save your high scores in Survival mode and compete against the entire world. We're hoping that we'll be able to foster a healthy community of high score chasers.

We have a few finishing touches to make on leaderboard support, I'd like for the scoreboard to display which hero(es) were used for that run, and how many people were playing (solo or co-op).


Additionally, there's a few new enemies, cards, and an entirely new playable Hero.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40770594/a58efeeb6397a24f90c8a3bed44a6d2db9920a8b.png[/img]


Look forward to Harvest Hero Origins in Q1 of 2022!
